objective: Verify Friday Project knowledge and saved handoff provide cross-chat continuity in regular Claude chat.
scenario: The owner finishes an ideation session, saves the generated STATUS_AND_HANDOFF.md to Project knowledge, then starts a new chat within the same Project.
expected_behaviors: Read and identify the latest saved handoff and its date/version.
Recover only documented decisions, open assumptions, blockers and next action.
Use Project knowledge across chats but do not claim the previous transcript is automatically available.
Treat Project memory as assistive, not a substitute for the versioned handoff.
prohibited_behaviors: Invent prior decisions from an older chat.
Claim automatic transcript sharing or perfect memory.
